`android/src/main/res/font/google_sans_flex.ttf` is byte-for-byte identical to
Tomato's pinned `shared/src/commonMain/composeResources/font/google_sans_flex.ttf`.
The bundled static instances differ from Tomato's variable font. They are
identified by the installed font metadata as Google Sans Flex and are covered
by the authoritative upstream OFL text copied in `OFL.txt`.
